etymologies.etymologyHTML: From sneak +‎ -y.

definitions.definition: Elusive; difficult to capture or observe due to constantly outwitting the adversaries.

quote.citation: 1995 April, Jeff Csatari, “Tackle Tips”, in Boys' Life, volume 85, number 4, Irving, Texas: Boy Scouts of America, Inc., →ISSN, page 42:

definitions.definition: (espionage, slang) Any device used for covert surveillance.

quote.citation: 1974, Miles Copeland, Without cloak or dagger: the truth about the new espionage, page 244:
quote.text: […]  in cooperation with the National Security Agency, installs and maintains "sneakies" throughout the U.S.S.R. and Communist China — but increasingly, denied areas are surveyed more simply.

quote.citation: 1991, Chapman Pincher, The Truth about Dirty Tricks:
quote.text: […]  has used travellers to plant 'sneakies' - small electronic transmitting devices which form part of a surveillance network.
